bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=2e2f12f75e5c48d7dc26703369309902de2cf716
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 61
test "$(git remote get-url origin | sed 's#\.git$##')" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/create-videobot" || exit 62
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 63
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
if test ! -d "$target"; then mkdir -p "$target"; git archive "$src" | tar -x -C "$target"; fi
grep -q 'legacyEditorTap' "$target/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs" || exit 64
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:poll-legacy-$src "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint /bin/sh create-videobot:poll-legacy-$src -c 'grep -q legacyEditorTap /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs && grep -q "Myビデオを見る" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs && command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null' || exit 66
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
pin="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/sticker-entry"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" && test -d "$pin" || exit 67
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 68
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$user" && test "$net" = deploy_default || exit 69
other="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$name" || true)"
test -z "$other" || exit 70
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$pin" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" config --quiet || exit 71
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:poll-rollback-legacy
docker image tag create-videobot:poll-legacy-$src create-videobot:local-poll
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 72
sleep 10
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 73
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 74
docker exec "$name" sh -c 'grep -q legacyEditorTap /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs && grep -q "Myビデオを見る" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs' || exit 75
echo VIDEO_LEGACY_EDITOR_REFRESH_LIVE=PASS
